profile.name: A2D可编程直流电子负载
profile.description: 这是一种可编程直流电子负载，用于以设定电流吸收功率，并测量电压、电流和温度等参数。它常用于电源、适配器、电池和其他直流供电设备的测试、放电与校准实验。
profile.description_en: This is a programmable DC electronic load that sinks a set current and measures parameters such as voltage, current, and temperature. It is commonly used for testing, discharging, and calibrating power supplies, adapters, batteries, and other DC power sources.

registry.name: A/D Electronic Load
registry.description: A/D Electronic Load是由A/D Instruments生产的电池测试柜，主要功能包括初始化、复位、数据保存、校准、测量、电流设置。支持Signal, Slot, get cal i等操作。
